tool: Any coding agent + a recorded model replay (no API key)
toolZh: 任一编码 Agent + 录制好的模型回放（无需 API Key）
title: Build LLM features in Python: structured output, tool calls, and evals
titleZh: 用 Python 构建 LLM 功能：结构化输出、工具调用与评测
summary: Turn a demo-day model call into a feature you can ship — validate structured output, allowlist tool calls, retry with the error fed back, fall back to a human instead of guessing, and measure it with an offline eval that divides by every case.
summaryZh: 把演示日的一次模型调用变成能上线的功能——校验结构化输出、给工具调用设白名单、带着错误信息重试、拿不准就转人工而不是瞎猜，并用分母覆盖全部用例的离线评测来度量。
outcome: A working ticket-triage feature (ticket_triage.py) that treats every model reply as untrusted input — validated output contract, tool-call allowlist, retry with the error fed back, human fallback — plus an offline eval with a pass/fail threshold you can replay on every change.
outcomeZh: 一个可运行的工单分诊功能（ticket_triage.py）：把每条模型回复当成不可信输入——经过校验的输出契约、工具调用白名单、带错误反馈的重试、人工兜底——外加一个每次改动都能回放、带通过阈值的离线评测。
prerequisites: Python 3.11 or newer available on your PATH
Any coding agent with the FlyPython Skill installed
Comfort running shell commands; standard library only
No model API key and no network access required
prerequisitesZh: PATH 中有 Python 3.11 或更新版本
任一装好 FlyPython Skill 的编码 Agent
能运行 shell 命令；仅用标准库
不需要模型 API Key，也不需要联网

lessons.title: A demo reply is not a feature
lessons.titleZh: 演示能跑不等于功能可靠
lessons.objective: Run the starter's eval, catch the number that cannot be true, and map every failing test to the real-world reply that breaks it.
lessons.objectiveZh: 跑一遍 starter 的评测，抓住那个不可能为真的数字，再把每个失败测试对应到让它坏掉的真实回复。

lessons.title: Write the output contract
lessons.objective: Read TASK.md as the boundary between your code and the model — what a reply must look like, which tools it may run, and what happens when it does not comply.
lessons.objectiveZh: 把 TASK.md 当成你的代码与模型之间的边界来读——回复必须长什么样、能运行哪些工具、不照做时怎么办。

lessons.title: Validate, allowlist tools, retry — one group at a time
lessons.titleZh: 校验、工具白名单、重试——一次一组
lessons.objective: Drive the starter to green in four bounded turns — parser, tool gate, retry-and-fallback loop, eval — and watch one fix expose a bug the old code was hiding.
lessons.objectiveZh: 用四个有界轮次把 starter 推到全绿——解析器、工具关口、重试与兜底循环、评测——并亲眼看到一处修复暴露出旧代码藏着的 bug。

lessons.title: Read the eval honestly
lessons.objective: Run all three skins, accept the one that fails its threshold, and write down what a handful of recorded replies can and cannot tell you.
lessons.objectiveZh: 跑完三个皮肤，接受那个没过阈值的结果，并写下少量录好的回复能说明什么、不能说明什么。

lessons.title: Apply it to your own LLM feature
lessons.titleZh: 接到你自己的模型功能上
lessons.objective: Put a real model behind the same seam: a callable client, an output contract, an allowlist, a fallback, and an eval you record once and replay on every change.
lessons.objectiveZh: 把真实模型放到同一个接缝后面：一个可调用的 client、一份输出契约、一张白名单、一个兜底，以及录一次、每次改动都回放的评测。

scenarios.title: IT helpdesk with a device lookup tool
scenarios.titleZh: IT 服务台（带设备查询工具）
scenarios.blurb: Classify internal tickets into five categories; the model may look up a device by asset tag first.
scenarios.blurbZh: 把内部工单分到五个类别；模型可以先按资产标签查询设备。

scenarios.title: SaaS feedback inbox
scenarios.blurb: Classify in-app feedback with no tools at all — the model answers from the ticket text alone.
scenarios.blurbZh: 完全不带工具地分类应用内反馈——模型只凭工单文本作答。

scenarios.title: Shop support with an order lookup tool
scenarios.titleZh: 商店客服（带订单查询工具）
scenarios.blurb: Classify a shop's support mail; the model may look up an order before answering.
scenarios.blurbZh: 分类商店的客服邮件；模型可以先查询订单再作答。

verification.method: A 15-test suite pins the output contract, the tool-call allowlist, retry with error feedback, the human fallback, and an eval that divides by every case. The starter reproduces the named failures; the reviewed solution passes 15/15 against recorded replies — no network, no API key.
verification.methodZh: 15 个测试锚定输出契约、工具调用白名单、带错误反馈的重试、人工兜底，以及分母覆盖全部用例的评测。starter 复现具名失败；已审核的实现对着录制回复通过 15/15——无需联网、无需 API Key。

level: Comfortable with functions, dictionaries, and exceptions
levelZh: 熟悉函数、字典与异常处理
